sourceCopy.name: Meeting Planner
sourceCopy.title: Meeting Planner: Free Time Zone Scheduler | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Find shared meeting times across time zones, including daylight-saving changes and overnight hours. Download a local ICS invite.
sourceCopy.intro: Compare a repeating daily availability window across an organizer and participants in different time zones. Review each local date and time, then download an ICS invite for a matching slot.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do I find a meeting time across time zones?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Enter the organizer’s IANA time zone, participant zones, a local date range, shared availability hours and meeting length. The planner checks real instants against local work windows, including date changes and daylight-saving offsets.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Does this connect to my calendar?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. All calculations run in your browser. The planner does not sign in, read calendars, upload your schedule or save your choices.

fields.participantZones: Participant time zones (one per line or comma-separated)
fields.zonesHint: Examples: America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo. The organizer is included automatically; use up to eight distinct zones total.
fields.privacyNote: Runs locally. No calendar connection, location request, upload, account, API or automatic save.
fields.scopeNote: Uses the same daily local-time window in every time zone. It does not know individual calendars, holidays, workdays or attendee preferences. Choose an actual slot with everyone before sending the invite.
fields.noResults: No matching slots found for these zones and hours. Try a wider window, a different date range or shorter meeting.
fields.dstNote: Daylight-saving rules come from this browser’s time-zone database and may be stale. If a fall-back time repeats, the earlier occurrence is selected; an availability boundary that does not exist during a spring-forward gap is skipped.

messages.invalid: Check the date, time-zone names, participant list, hours and limits.
messages.noResults: No shared slots match. Try a longer range or broader availability.
messages.found: {count} possible slots found. Times are shown in each participant’s zone.
messages.downloaded: ICS invite downloaded. Review its date and time before sharing.
messages.exampleLoaded: Example loaded: New York, London and Tokyo zones.

additionalFaqs.question: Does it check Google Calendar or Outlook availability?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It compares the same hours you enter for each time zone. It cannot see anyone’s appointments, holidays, working weekdays or personal preferences.

additionalFaqs.question: Does it account for daylight saving time?
additionalFaqs.answer: It uses the browser’s IANA time-zone database to convert each candidate instant. A database may be out of date; verify important meeting times with participants.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I add the suggested meeting to a calendar?
additionalFaqs.answer: Download an ICS event for a selected slot and import it yourself. The tool does not connect to or modify any calendar.
